cases.input: The Pentagon said a Russian Su-27 fighter intercepted a U.S. RC-135 reconnaissance aircraft over the Baltic Sea on Tuesday. U.S. officials described the intercept as unsafe because the Russian jet came within 20 feet of the American plane. Moscow said its aircraft was identifying an unknown aircraft in international airspace and denied any unsafe maneuver. No injuries were reported and both planes returned to base.
